2607.22075.title: FSE: Continual Learning for Named Entity Recognition by Fast-Slow Experts
2607.22075.paper_summary: Continual Learning for Named Entity Recognition (CLNER) enable models to incrementally learn new entity types without forgetting previously acquired ones. However, existing methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and insufficient exploitation of shared information across tasks. This paper proposes FSE, a Fast-Slow Experts enhanced span-based NER model for CLNER. The shared fast expert learns token-level links to efficiently filter out unlikely spans, while the task-specific slow expert performs span classification only on the remaining candidates. It stabilizes learning by promoting knowledge sharing across tasks and maintains plasticity by reducing learning burden at each task. A length-decay negative sampling strategy to mitigate span imbalance is also introduced. Extensive experiments on OntoNotes and FewNERD synthestic datasets demonstrate that FSE achieves state-of-the-art performance in CLNER scenarios, with effectiveness of each component, empirical evidence of faster convergence and expected functionality of both experts.
2607.22075.paper_summary_zh: 持續學習命名實體識別 (CLNER) 使模型能夠逐步學習新的實體類型，而不會遺忘之前獲得的類型。<lb/>然而，現有的方法面臨災難性遺忘和跨任務共享信息利用不足的問題。<lb/>本文提出了 FSE，一種針對 CLNER 的增強型基於跨度的快速-慢速專家模型。<lb/>共享的快速專家學習標記級別的鏈接，以有效過濾不太可能的跨度，而特定任務的慢速專家僅對剩餘候選者進行跨度分類。<lb/>它通過促進跨任務的知識共享來穩定學習，並通過減少每個任務的學習負擔來保持可塑性。<lb/>還引入了一種長度衰減的負採樣策略，以減輕跨度不平衡問題。<lb/>在 OntoNotes 和 FewNERD 合成數據集上的大量實驗表明，FSE 在 CLNER 場景中達到了最先進的性能，並展示了每個組件的有效性、快速收斂的實證證據以及兩個專家的預期功能。
